Also computes selectors from signatures you pass (e.g. "transfer(address,ui

tools.description: Decode EVM calldata (any chain, no RPC) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Decode transaction input data into function name, signature and typed named arguments. tools.name: evm_logs
tools.description: Decode EVM event logs (any chain, no RPC) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Decode up to 50 raw logs ({topics, data, address}) from a receipt into event names and typed arguments. Uses your ABI, a Sourcify-verified ABI (chain_id + address), or the 4byte event database, trying indexed-paramet

tools.name: evm_abi
tools.description: Verified contract ABI (Sourcify, any EVM chain) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Get the verified ABI, contract name, compiler and match level for a contract on any Sourcify-supported chain, with proxy detection and the implementation ABI merged in. Returns function/event selectors alongsid

tools.name: evm_encode
tools.description: Encode EVM calldata from a signature ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Build 0x calldata from a function signature and arguments (e.g. "transfer(address,uint256)" + ["0x…", "1000000"]). Numbers may be strings; returns selector and calldata ready for eth_call or a transaction. HTTP POST https

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evm_selector, evm_calldata, evm_abi · Private data: evm_calldata, evm_logs · Public sink: evm_selector, evm_calldata, evm_logs, evm_abi, evm_encode · Destructive: evm_selector, evm_calldata.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evm_selector, evm_calldata, evm_abi · Private data: evm_calldata, evm_logs · Public sink: evm_selector, evm_calldata, evm_logs, evm_abi, evm_encode · Destructive: evm_selector, evm_calldata

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
